content.text: Voutsout yue eiteh a lahuen ka patak sak e tami teh,
hawinae awm laipalah hmawi a rawk han.
Tamikalan ni kâtawnnae a tawn toteh tamimaya a konawm awh,
hatei tamikathout ni a uk navah tamimaya a cingou awh.
Lungangnae ka ngai e ni a na pa a konawm sak,
hatei kâyawt e hoi kamyawng e tami ni a hnopai koung a pâbaw.
Siangpahrang ni lawkcengnae lahoi ram a caksak,
hatei tadawnghno ni ram a rawk sak.
A imri laithoe lahoi ka oup e teh a khok kâman nahanlah
tamlawk a yangda pouh.
Kâtapoenae ni tamikathout a man,
hatei tamikalan teh la sak lahoi a lunghawi.
Tamikalan ni tamimathoe hanlah a pouk,
hatei tamikathout ni teh banglahai noutna hoeh.
Kadudamnaw ni khopui hmai a sawi,
hatei tamilungkaang ni teh lungkhueknae a takhoe thai.
Tamilungkaang ni tamipathu hoi kâyue pawiteh,
tamipathu a panui hai thoseh,
a lungphuen hai thoseh banglahai tho hoeh.
Tami kathetnaw ni tamikalan a hmuhma awh,
tamikalan teh hawinae hah a tawng.
Tamipathu ni a pouk e pueng hah a dei,
hatei tamilungkaang ni teh a panguep.
Ukkung ni laithoe dei e banghai nahoeh tet pawiteh,
a sannaw pueng teh tamikathout lah koung a coung awh.
Tamimathoe hoi repcoungroenaw ni cungtalah a hmawng e teh,
BAWIPA ni a mit reirei a ang sak.
Atangcalah tamimathoe hanelah
lawkcengkung siangpahrang teh,
a bawitungkhung a yungyoe caksak lah ao han.
Bongpai hoi yuenae ni tami a lungangsak teh,
ka pangak e camo ni a manu yeirai a po sak.
Tamikathout apapnae koe kâtapoenae apap,
hatei tamikalan ni a rawk awh e hah a hmu.
Na capa hah yue yaw lannae na poe han,
hothloilah hring nawmnae na poe han.
Vision ohoehnae koe tami pueng a thathoe awh,
hatei kâlawk ka tarawi e teh tami yawkahawi e doeh.
San teh lawk hoi dueng yue thai lah awm hoeh,
bangkongtetpawiteh a thai eiteh tarawi laipalah ao thai.
Pouk laipalah lawk ka deirumram e ouk na hmu ou,
hot patet e tami koe hlak teh
tamipathu koe ngaihawine bet aohnawn.
Camo nah ekvoi pahren e san teh a cue torei teh
calan e lah ao han.
A lung ka khuek e ni kâyuenae a tâcokhai teh,
ka matheng e ni kâtapoenae pou a tâcokhai.
Ma e kâoupnae ni na rahnoumsak han,
hatei muitha lahoi kârahnoum e ni barinae a coe.
Tamru hoi kamyawng e teh
amae hringnae ka hmuhma e tami doeh,
lawkkatang dei hanelah thoe a kâbo ei dei kalawn hoeh.
Tami barinae ni karap patetlah na man,
hatei BAWIPA kâuep e teh rungngang lah ao han.
Tami kapap ni ukkungnaw e lungyouknae hah a tawng awh,
hatei taminaw hanelah lawkcengnae teh
BAWIPA koehoi doeh a tho.
Tamikalanhoehe teh tamikalan hanelah panuet a tho e patetlah,
tamikalan teh tamikalanhoehnaw hanelah panuet a tho van.
